preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.
The input contains exactly m edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for e in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The graph is simple (no self-loops or multi-edges).
A necessary condition for partitioning edges into pairs is that the total number of edges must be even.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (len(paths) == m // 2 and all(all((u, v) in edge_set and (v, w) in edge_set for u, v, w in path) for path in paths) and len(set(tuple(sorted(e)) for path in paths for e in [(path[0], path[1]), (path[1], path[2])])) == m)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output contains exactly m/2 paths, each consisting of two adjacent edges present in the graph, and every edge in the graph appears in exactly one path. If no solution exists, the output is 'No solution'.
